renet/bevy_renet provides server-authoritative UDP transport for Bevy
Bevy WASM currently single-threaded; web-multi-threading feature unstable and requires nightly
WebAssembly Memory64 shipped Chrome 133, Edge 133, Firefox 134; Safari not yet
WASM threads require SharedArrayBuffer which requires COOP/COEP cross-origin isolation
WebGPU browser support: Chrome/Edge 113+, Firefox 141+ Windows, Safari 26+
Solari real-time path tracer for Bevy 0.17+ uses wgpu raytracing, ReSTIR DI/GI, DLSS Ray Reconstruction
Veloren chunk data structure performance: 17.7 ns/voxel to 3.6 ns/voxel full read

binary-greedy-meshing Rust crate ported from cgerikj, used in Bevy game Riverbed

Bevy 0.16 release notes cover GPU-driven rendering (MDI/MDIC, bindless, GPU transform/cull, retained render world), platform support (Vulkan full, Metal partial, WebGPU transform-only, WebGL2 none), and rendering features (deferred rendering optional since 0.12, SSAO since 0.11, bloom/DOF built-in, procedural atmosphere).
Roblox action/story RPGs demonstrate blocky visuals support fast combat and quest campaigns at scale
Deep Rock Galactic uses destructible smoothed-voxel caves with varied rock hardness
Trove class-based action combat and event-style campaign content in voxel MMO
Hytale world structure: curated procedural Orbis with zones, factions, dungeons, story campaign
Hytale combat system includes stamina, blocking, parrying, directional dodging, weapon signatures, multi-phase bosses
Enemy telegraphs are critical for fair, readable combat difficulty
Poise mechanics and hyper armor in Dark Souls / Elden Ring
Dodge roll i-frames and equip load affect roll speed/recovery in Elden Ring
Academic analysis of Soulslike combat design and core loop
Soulslike combat loop: stamina governs attacks, dodges, blocks, parries, sprinting; depletion leaves player vulnerable
wry/Tauri webviews delegate WebGPU to the OS webview: Windows WebView2 supports it from runtime 113+, macOS 26+ WKWebView supports it, and Linux WebKitGTK support is not reliable.
Bevygap demonstrates autoscaling headless Bevy dedicated game servers using Edgegap and Lightyear.
Veloren server runs at 30 TPS, uses separate PING/CHUNK/GAMESTATE channels with LZ4 compression; a 53-player stress test averaged ~280 ms tick time and default max_players is 100.
Lightyear is a server-authoritative networking library for Bevy with client-side prediction, rollback, interpolation, snapshot interpolation, and WASM/WebTransport support.
Bevy WASM builds default to WebGL2; WebGPU is opt-in via the webgpu Cargo feature. A single WASM binary with runtime WebGL2/WebGPU detection is not yet implemented (issue #13168).
WebGPU global support is ~77.4% (web3dsurvey) to ~83.6% (caniuse) as of mid-2026, with Linux support only ~11%.
drusniel-voxels-bevy demo shows chunk LOD plus Radiance Cascades, SDF raymarch, GTAO, PCSS, and volumetric fog in Bevy 0.18.
bevy_transvoxels_demo implements Transvoxel 6-LOD with crack-free transition cells and async meshing for Bevy 0.18.
binary-greedy-meshing crate implements Binary Greedy Meshing v2 and benchmarks at ~65 microseconds per opaque chunk on a Ryzen 5 5500.
Bevy 0.16 (April 2025) shipped GPU-driven rendering: MDI/MDIC, Mesh Allocator, bindless material/texture allocator, GPU transform/cull, retained render world, cached pipeline specialization.
Bevy 0.19 was released 2026-06-19 with built-in physically based SSR, contact shadows, rectangular area lights, partial bindless, render-graph-as-systems, and cancellable web tasks.

A Bevy Merge Train gist by alice-i-cecile (2026-03-30) summarizes a rendering PR by pcwalton that unpacks multidrawable batch-set bins on the GPU instead of the CPU, representing a step toward GPU-driven rendering in Bevy.

Bevy Solari (introduced in Bevy 0.17, September 2025) is an experimental real-time ray-traced GI system using ReSTIR DI/GI and a world-space irradiance cache. Its denoising/upscaling currently depends on NVIDIA DLSS Ray Reconstruction, making Solari effectively NVIDIA-only (RTX GPUs) via Vulkan on Windows/Linux.
source: Realtime Raytracing in Bevy 0.17 (Solari) by JMS55

claim: Bevy 0.15 (released 2024-11-29) replaced the previous GTAO screen-space ambient occlusion implementation with VBAO (Visibility Bitmask Ambient Occlusion). The component is still named ScreenSpaceAmbientOcclusion.

Voxelis is a pure Rust voxel engine based on Sparse Voxel Octree DAG (SVO-DAG), offering high memory compression, batch editing, and a mesher. It is designed for integration with Rust, C++, Godot, or Bevy projects.
binary-greedy-meshing is a Rust crate that implements Binary Greedy Meshing v2 and is used in Bevy voxel projects such as Riverbed. It is a practical alternative when greedy meshing is required.

bevy_meshem supports naive meshing and face-culling for voxel grids, but explicitly does NOT support greedy meshing. Users needing greedy meshing should use binary-greedy-meshing or implement it themselves.

There is no turnkey Bevy MMO voxel backend. Recommended server-authoritative architecture: separate Rust server with deterministic simulation, chunk storage in RocksDB/Sled/Redb, UDP/QUIC delta streaming with interest management, and Bevy client for rendering/input. Crates such as bevy_replicon and Renet exist for smaller-scale replication but MMO scale usually requires custom networking.

Bevy 0.19 out-of-box supports deferred PBR, PBR specular, bloom, DOF, motion blur, volumetric fog/lighting, lightmaps/reflection probes. SSAO (VBAO) and Solari realtime ray-traced GI require native compute/hardware RT and do not work on WebGL2/WebGPU. Path-traced GI in browser is not provided out-of-box; baked GI is the practical fallback.

Bevy web builds default to WebGL2; WebGPU is opt-in. WebGPU shipped in all major browsers by late 2025 (Chrome 113+, Firefox 141+ Windows, Safari 26). WASM threads require SharedArrayBuffer and cross-origin isolation headers COOP same-origin + COEP require-corp. No verified public list of shipped Bevy WebGPU browser-only titles as of mid-2026.

Bevy voxel rendering ecosystem 2025-2026: closest open-source reference is Veloren (greedy meshing + terrain LOD); active crates include bevy_voxel_world (multithreaded chunk LOD), binary_greedy_mesher_demo, Bevy Meshem, and voxelis (SVDAG). Bevy engine is moving toward GPU-driven multidraw rendering in 2026.
source: This Week in Bevy: Mesh generation, Voxels, and terminals (2024-12-30)
